_note: Synthetic data for a demo. Not real people.

items.title: SQL for Analysts
items.description: Learn to query, filter and join tables to answer business questions. Practice on realistic sample tables.

items.title: Python Foundations
items.description: Write your first Python programs: variables, loops, functions and files. Ends with a small automation project.

items.title: Statistics for Machine Learning
items.description: Covers distributions, sampling, hypothesis tests and how to judge a model fairly. Built for people heading into model work.

items.title: Intro to Machine Learning
items.description: Train and evaluate your first models in Python, from simple predictions to measuring accuracy. Hands-on exercises throughout.

items.title: Deep Learning Basics
items.description: Build small neural networks and learn how they are trained. Needs prior machine learning experience.

items.title: Building LLM Applications
items.description: Build an application that calls a language model, exposes it through an API and handles bad answers safely.

items.title: Prompt Engineering Essentials
items.description: A short course on writing clear prompts, giving examples and testing the results.

items.title: Docker for Developers
items.description: Package an application in a container and run it on a cloud server. Covers images, volumes and basic deployment.

items.title: Data Pipelines with Python
items.description: Design pipelines that load, clean and move information on a schedule. Uses Python and SQL throughout.

items.title: Agile Product Management
items.description: Plan a product in short cycles, work with stakeholders and prioritise a backlog. Suited to coordinators and new managers.
